nfr: Acceptance target: a representative authenticated task-detail GET has p95<=500 ms, chosen to keep local task navigation responsive. Test conditions: localhost, one sequential client, one warm-up, 40 measured requests, Microsoft JDK 21 / Payara 6 / H2. Before the JDBC lifecycle change the same target failed at p95=699.81 ms. Closing the last H2 connection repeatedly shut down/reopened the file database; final source adds DB_CLOSE_DELAY=10 and explicit application shutdown. The final run passed: p95=39.31 ms, min=20.66 ms, max=40.70 ms. Both failed and passing records are preserved. This measures the development-machine API under light load, not mobile network latency or production capacity.
